description: Mechanically checkable subset of voices/<name>.md. Judgment rules stay in the markdown; only put a rule here if a regex can decide it.
_how_to_use: Copy to voices/<name>.rules.json and edit. Delete every underscore-prefixed key.
default_priority sets the tier for entries that do not name one. P0 = a hit is a defect.
Anything you leave out is simply not enforced. An empty file is valid.

_options.oxford_comma: require | forbid | allow  (advisory, reported not enforced)

_banned_words_note: Single words, matched case-insensitively on word boundaries. Inflections are not automatic, list them.
_banned_phrases_note: Multi-word strings. Whitespace between words matches any run of whitespace, so a phrase still matches across a line break.
_banned_regex_note: Full control. Each entry needs id, label, rx. Optional: priority (P0/P1/P2), max_allowed (flag only past N hits, for overuse rather than a ban), note.

banned_regex.label: Example, delete this
banned_regex.note: Shown so the shape is obvious. Delete it.

_required_when_note: Advisory presence checks. Fires when none of any_of_rx matches. Keep these at P2: a fragment of a longer document legitimately has no greeting or sign-off.
_preferred_substitutions_note: Not enforced. Shown to the editor as the replacement to reach for when a banned entry is hit.
